_comment: PPU review pool for every ppuR slider on personalitypopup.com. Order = rank (best first). q = full review text (verbatim), s = optional short excerpt for compact sliders (Book). Pages pull this live; the daily ppu-google-review-count task adds new 5-star Google reviews here.

reviews.q: I cannot believe these photos!!!!! Best money I spent all year. On anything. And I spend a lot of money 😂 The process was a breeze. Fun for the kids and not stressful. But I would've paid double if I knew they'd come out so incredible. Thank you so so much!!!

I am literally crying looking at these pictures of my kids. They are pictures I will love and stare at the rest of my life!!!! They actually captured my son's real smile when we usually get strained smiles in photos. He was full on giggling and smiling so genuinely.
reviews.s: I am literally crying looking at these pictures of my kids. They actually captured my son's real smile.

reviews.q: I would give you 6 stars if I could. These are priceless. I am so picky and hard to impress when it comes to pictures or anything aesthetic — and you KILLED IT!! I LOVE all of the photos!! I cannot believe how many great shots you got that truly capture their little (or big) personalities.
reviews.s: I would give you 6 stars if I could. I am so picky and hard to impress, and you KILLED IT.

reviews.q: I found them through a random Instagram ad (which I would normally scroll right past), but for some reason decided to give it a shot — and I'm so glad I did. I opened my gallery this morning and actually teared up (in the best way). We will cherish these photos forever.

I got Instagram targeted for the Personality Popup coming to our area and, against my better judgement, shelled out for the expensive 15 minute session. My husband was less than enthused. We just got the photos back and I am floored. They are better than I even imagined. I would do this shoot every year if I could! 10/10 recommend

These pictures brought tears to my eyes INSTANTLY. Thank you for taking the edge off pictures, being so kind and non judgmental with our kids, and being incredibly talented at your craft. These are AMAZING!

This is the most beautiful and amazing thing I have ever seen. I booked this on a whim as a birthday present for myself and this made every penny worth it. Your photos will be a part of our family and all over our home for the rest of our lives!
As an avid family that does 3-5 sets of photo sessions a year if not more — there is a difference with this product. The quality, style, experience of the photography is unmatched.
reviews.s: There is a difference with this product. The quality, style, experience is unmatched.

reviews.q: The warmest and kindest team with the best experience! Laura made it so easy for my daughter to feel comfortable and get her shots. I was so eager to get her portraits back and was blown away with the results!
reviews.s: The warmest and kindest team with the best experience! Laura made it so easy for my daughter to feel comfortable and get her shots.

reviews.q: 10/10! I knew the photos would likely turn out lovely, but I wasn't expecting to enjoy the shoot day itself so much. 15 minutes turned out to be more than enough time and the vibes were so easygoing and happy. My husband and I left saying 'that was already worth it'.
reviews.s: My husband and I left saying "that was already worth it." 10/10!
